senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) fatty concretion (cmp. חַלָּא), esp. that abdominal fat of cattle which it is forbidden to eat, ḥeleb (Lev. III, 17), contrad. to שומן.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 113b:12">Ḥull. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>המבשל חֵ׳ בחָלָב</he> if one boils fat with milk.
Snh. 4ᵇ חֵלֶב וחָלָב דכי וכ׳ ḥeleb a. ḥalab which are written alike, v. אֵם; a. fr.—Pl. חֲלָבִים, חֲלָבִין.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite> <he>ח׳ ואברים</he> the pieces of fat and the limbs belonging to the altar; <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 7:3">Tam. VII, 3</cite> <he>שלחן הח׳</he> the (marble) table designated for the fat-pieces (and limbs).—
Ker. 12ᵃ, sq. חֲלָבִין laws concerning the eating of ḥeleb; Y. Yeb. X, 11ᵃ top מדמי לה לח׳ (not לחלבון); a. fr.—[Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ bot. לובן חלבין, v. חֶלְבּוֹן.]—גוּשׁ הֵ׳, v. גּוּשׁ.
